$Comment: Head of the Table: reach Exalted with Martha, the rank her favor calls Head of the Table.
Earned once and kept. Favor with Martha carries from one feast to the next, so this file has no
Parent: the yearly skeleton would mint a copy each year that every Exalted player collects again at
login for nothing. It carries no full_table tag either, which keeps it out of The Full Table.
REPUTATION_RANK credits every rank a player's favor has reached, each time their favor changes and
when they log in. Target is the rank id and Qualifier the reputation id. The criterion's TextKey
words the step with Martha's own rank name. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id
harvest_feast_head_of_the_table, and its words come from the keys that id spells.
It pays the title Harvest_Feast_Head_Of_The_Table through the Title reward kind, on unlock: a title
is the one thing an achievement pays without waiting to be collected.
